name: autopsy_HI_look
_status: TEMPLATE written 2026-11-12 before any 2022+ read; revised the same day after the harness review (fixes F1-F7, F10). The lead edits 'changes_in_look' (and, for a change other than K1 / K2 / K3, its 'criteria'), then declares the look in the protocol by quoting the string autopsy_HI_look and the full sha256 of THIS file after its last edit, then runs look.py ONCE. proofs.py rehearses this file at CUT 2022-01-01 on the in-sample windows (every available change, and the list as it stands through look.py).
_changes_in_look: THE LIST THE LEAD EDITS BEFORE THE DECLARATION. Only the changes named here enter the look; everything else stays available in this file. Mechanically (vhi_run.select_changes): a sleeve with a change enters iff its id is listed; a '<sleeve>@payoff' reference enters iff one of its variants does; the ten unchanged sleeves always enter; a portfolio enters iff all its sleeves (and the ids of its stake rules) do; a comparison iff both its portfolios. The default list is K1, K2, K3 only: no payoff variant, no stake rule. A stake rule of Addendum I enters only as a portfolio stake spec carrying an 'id' listed here. An id that is not available is refused.

notes.declaration: look.py runs a CUT after 2022-01-01 only when LOOK_DECLARED names the protocol addendum whose text contains the string autopsy_HI_look and the full sha256 (64 hexadecimal characters) of this file, the exact bytes that run: sha256sum lab/r2/tracks/validation_hi/look_spec.json after its last edit. Any edit of this file, the list of changes included, changes that sha256. The command: LOOK_DECLARED=<addendum> NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/numba_validation_hi PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 lab/r2/tracks/validation_hi/look.py --spec lab/r2/tracks/validation_hi/look_spec.json --cut 2026-01-01.
notes.run_once: The look is run once. look.py refuses it when results/val_access.log already holds a line with track autopsy_HI_look or a '<stem>.started' marker exists in results/r2/validation_hi/look/, unless --second-access '<reason>' is given; the reason is then written into the access label and the output gets the suffix __access<N>. --out is refused for a look: the output is results/r2/validation_hi/look/autopsy_HI_look__cut2026-01-01.json (+ __trades.parquet). The access line is appended, then the '.started' marker written, before anything is read.
notes.changes: The changes judged are the list changes_in_look (default: K1, K2, K3). P0 = the ten unchanged sleeves; P1 = P0 with K1; P2 = P0 with K1, K2 and K3; P0+orb_eth = P0 with K2; P0+orb_btc = P0 with K3. Nothing is re-tuned: rules and parameters are those of r2/recalc.py::sleeves() (orb_asia_2d_buf10 = FINALISTS['orb_asia_2d_buf10'] of lab/tracks/orb/strategy.py).
notes.k1_labels: K1's walk-forward labels are every signal taken alone with FP costs, in both cost modes (labels_mode 'fp': synthesis_B's declaration, 'every signal taken alone with FP costs'). The thresholds are fitted on that FP table (signals decided before 1 January Y minus 7 days, usable = filled, not refused, not still open at the frame end; terciles, q = 1/3; the worse side skipped only if min(E_lo, E_hi) < 0; at least 100 training signals; history from 31 January of Y-1). In the x1.5 run the skip is applied with each signal's own riskbp of that run and the orders refused alone (stop under 3 spreads) are those of x1.5. In sample this changes only E_lo / E_hi of the x1.5 folds: same folds, same T(2022) = 478.284 bp, same x1.5 chain (proof b).
notes.k1_T2022: T(2022) = 478.284 bp is binding: at CUT 2026 the walk-forward's 2022 fold (fitted on the signals decided before 2021-12-25) must be within 0.01 bp of it, in each cost mode, otherwise the run raises before any result is written (T(2022) = 478.28 bp of synthesis_B's text is within that tolerance). T(2023), T(2024), T(2025) are refitted on each 1 January by the same procedure.
notes.live: 'As the live program would' (execution 'live'): every order that fills under the lab rules is entered one minute late at market (the open of the bar after its lab fill bar, ask / bid x (1 +/- market slippage)); an absolute stop stays at its price, a stop distance stays a distance from the new fill; time exits, trailing and break-even distances unchanged. One position per sleeve, 'entry_bar' (the synthesis_B verifiers' way, quoted in synthesis_B: 'run as the current hands would'): the chain is re-simulated with the live exits and the one-position test is made at the delayed entry bar. Friday close: every position still open is closed at market at the open of the first bar starting at or after Friday 16:50 New York (the hands' InpFridayClose = 23:50 server) of the first Friday on or after its entry's New-York date; a us100 position still open on Friday 16:50 New York (us100 is already shut then, about 16:15 New York) is closed at the next reopen, at the open of its first bar. Friday block ('decision_and_entry'): a signal is not taken when its decision instant (the close of its lab fill bar) or its delayed entry bar falls at or after Friday 16:50 New York and before the Sunday 17:00 New York reopen. The broker's 3-spread refusal is applied at the live fill bar with that bar's open spread; a refused order never blocks the sleeve. The K1 skip is decided exactly as in lab.
notes.equal_weekly_swing: In every comparison the variant's stakes are scaled by k = weekly sd of the reference / weekly sd of the variant, both measured on the judged window (the look: 2022-01-01 .. 2025-12-31, in the row's cost mode, execution and account): the scale factors are recomputed on the window, not fixed in sample; every amount of 'var_equal_swing' is at that scale ('scale_k' is reported).
notes.accounts: Two accounts, both reported. 'sum': every trade of every sleeve's own one-position chain at 1 R (times its stake; no position cap, no compounding): synthesis_B's portfolio metrics, the account the criteria are judged on. 'capped': the same trades offered in entry order (ties within a minute in ASCII order of '<rule>_<sym>') to an account that holds at most 6 positions and 2 per market (r2/tracks/stake/account.py limits); a position blocks a new entry until its exit time is strictly before that entry; a refused trade leaves its sleeve's chain unchanged; run over the whole frame (state warm at the window start), judged on the window.
notes.weeks: Server weeks Monday to Sunday, server time = New York + 7 h, a trade booked in the week (day) of its exit time. The weekly series runs from the week of 2022-01-01 to the week of 2025-12-31 23:59, every week counted (a week without an exit is 0), so the first week (27 Dec 2021 - 2 Jan 2022) is 0; sd with ddof 1; weekly Sharpe = mean / sd x sqrt(52). By year: the trades entered in the year over the weeks whose Thursday falls in it, the window's first and last weeks clipped into 2022 and 2025.
notes.costs_and_conventions: Costs: FP (r2.costs(sym), the FP frames as they are) and x1.5 (spread and slippage x1.5 around the mid, orders rebuilt on the widened quotes). Convention 'sB' (the ten, K1, K2, K3): an order whose stop is closer than 3 spreads of its fill bar is not taken (iterative re-simulation of the one-position chain); trades still open at the last bar of the frame are dropped. Frames from their start to the last bar before the CUT (warm-up from in-sample bars); trades entered 2022-01-01 .. 2025-12-31 are judged; K2 and K3 are held through weekends as specified (lab).
notes.payoff_references: '<sleeve>@payoff' (only when a payoff variant is listed): the payoff lens's convention with the broker refusal before the simulation, as its variants get it (an order whose stop at its alone fill is under 3 spreads of the fill bar is removed); res['payoff_reference_vs_sB'] reports every trade difference from the sB sleeve inside the window (in sample: none, lab, FP and x1.5).
notes.criteria: res['verdicts'] computes the declared criteria mechanically from the trades (unrounded): K1 (synthesis_B): expectancy per trade with the skip higher than without and total R not lower, FP and x1.5 (lab), and the skipped signals taken alone (FP costs) earning less on average than the kept ones. K2, K3 (synthesis_B): with FP costs PF >= 1.06, expectancy > 0, every-signal expectancy > 0, total R positive in at least 3 of the 4 years 2022-2025, expectancy > 0 with costs x1.5, and weekly mean / sd of R of the ten plus that sleeve (P0+orb_eth, P0+orb_btc; plain sum, FP, lab) at least that of the ten alone (P0); plus the reading, not a criterion, 'as the live program would' (FP, live): expectancy <= 0 means the sleeve waits for a robot that holds it over the weekend. No criterion is declared for the payoff variants or any stake rule: one listed in changes_in_look gets 'declared: false' until the lead adds its criterion under 'criteria' (a kind registered with vhi_verdicts.register_criterion).

_how_to_add_a_change: add a sleeve {key, rule, sym, convention, change {kind, id, ...}} (change kinds: k1_riskbp, payoff, new, or one registered with vhi_sleeves.register_change), put its key in a portfolio, add a comparison and, before the declaration, its id in changes_in_look and its criterion under criteria. Stakes: portfolios[P].stakes[<sleeve key>] = a stake spec of vhi_stakes.from_spec (const, sleeve_year, trade_table, wf_terciles, python) carrying an 'id'.
_live_one_position: entry_bar = the synthesis_B verifiers' 'run as the current hands would' (entry one minute late at market, Friday 16:50 New York close, chain re-simulated, one-position test at the delayed entry bar); alternatives: 'rule' (the rule's own test at its activation bar) or 'lab_chain' (only the lab chain's trades, executed live)
_live_friday_block: decision_and_entry = no new position when the decision instant (close of the lab fill bar) OR the delayed entry bar falls in Friday 16:50 .. Sunday 17:00 New York; alternative 'entry_bar' (the delayed entry bar only)

K1.text: synthesis_B: K1 is adopted only if, on 2022-2025, the sleeve's expectancy per trade with the skip is higher than without and its total R is not lower, both with FP costs and with costs x1.5, and the skipped signals taken alone earn less on average than the kept ones.

K2.text: synthesis_B: each new sleeve is adopted only if, with FP costs, PF >= 1.06, expectancy > 0, every-signal expectancy > 0, total R positive in at least 3 of the 4 years, and expectancy > 0 with costs x1.5; and the weekly mean / sd of R of the ten plus that sleeve is at least that of the ten alone. Read beside it, for the robot as it is (not a criterion of the rule): the same sleeve with entry one minute late and every position closed on Friday at 16:50 New York; if that version has expectancy <= 0, the sleeve waits for a robot that holds it over the weekend.

K3.text: synthesis_B: each new sleeve is adopted only if, with FP costs, PF >= 1.06, expectancy > 0, every-signal expectancy > 0, total R positive in at least 3 of the 4 years, and expectancy > 0 with costs x1.5; and the weekly mean / sd of R of the ten plus that sleeve is at least that of the ten alone. Read beside it, for the robot as it is (not a criterion of the rule): the same sleeve with entry one minute late and every position closed on Friday at 16:50 New York; if that version has expectancy <= 0, the sleeve waits for a robot that holds it over the weekend.
